items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was Carmen‘s manager? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I went to see her one night... I had said to Larry Closier... He said, ―You would?‖

ctx.x: How did the idea of the album come about? Was it more of a record company decision?
No. Sarah died. Well, I had said to Larry Closier [phonetic], I said . . .
